title: Remote viewers foresee catastrophic sea level rise by 2050

tellings.quote: >> So, a number of remote viewers have remote viewed the year 2050.

plain: Several remote viewers, people who say they can see distant places and times with the mind alone, have looked ahead to the year 2050 and seen the seas rising catastrophically over coastal cities around the world. A philosopher named Jason Jorjani tells this, passing on what he has from the remote viewing researchers Stephan Schwartz and Lyn Buchanan.
